title: Jets agree to three year contract extension with Breece Hall

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets agree to three year contract extension with Breece Hall
sources.description: After the NFL Draft, one of the top business items for the Jets was working out a long-term contract extension with running back Breece Hall. Hall was given the franchise tag at the start of the offseason, but the team had indicated that getting a deal done was a priority. Hall has agreed to a […]
